pr_title: [Fix #12795] Fix `Layout/BlockAlignment` for blocks that are the body of an endless method
pr_body:

Fixes #12795.

issue_context.title: Layout/BlockAlignment does not recognize "start of line" containing endless method
issue_context.body:
Based on the rule description for `Layout/BlockAlignment` with `start_of_line`

> the end shall be aligned with the start of the line where the expression started

I would expect this

```
def foo = bar(123,
              456) do
  # ...
end
```

to be allowed, but it isn't. It seems that "start of the line" actually means the start of the method body, and not the actual line.

--------

## Expected behavior

No offense

## Actual behavior

```
woot.rb:4:1: C: [Correctable] Layout/BlockAlignment: end at 4, 0 is not aligned with bar(123, at 1, 10 or 456) do at 2, 14.
end
^^^
```

## Steps to reproduce the problem

* Enable `Layout/BlockAlignment` with `EnforcedStyleAlignWith` set to `start_of_line` or `either`
* Lint the code block above

## RuboCop version

```
1.62.1 (using Parser 3.3.0.5, rubocop-ast 1.31.2, running on ruby 3.2.2) [arm64-darwin21]
  - rubocop-rails 2.22.1
```
comments: `ElseAlignment` also has this issue, but not `EndAlignment` or `BeginEndAlignment`, interestingly.

> ElseAlignment also has this issue, but not EndAlignment or BeginEndAlignment, interestingly.

@jedediah I haven't been able to replicate this, if you have a replication case please open a separate issue for it, thanks.

review_comments:
The same behavior is expected for endless singleton method definitions as well. Below is a part of the patch example:

```diff
diff --git a/lib/rubocop/cop/layout/block_alignment.rb b/lib/rubocop/cop/layout/block_alignment.rb
index 195e989e5..13a7d94ff 100644
--- a/lib/rubocop/cop/layout/block_alignment.rb
+++ b/lib/rubocop/cop/layout/block_alignment.rb
@@ -74,6 +74,7 @@ module RuboCop
         def_node_matcher :block_end_align_target?, <<~PATTERN
           {assignment?
            def
+           defs
            splat
            and
            or
diff --git a/spec/rubocop/cop/layout/block_alignment_spec.rb b/spec/rubocop/cop/layout/block_alignment_spec.rb
index 5bc577fa6..80518d7bf 100644
--- a/spec/rubocop/cop/layout/block_alignment_spec.rb
+++ b/spec/rubocop/cop/layout/block_alignment_spec.rb
@@ -743,6 +743,21 @@ RSpec.describe RuboCop::Cop::Layout::BlockAlignment, :config do
           end
         RUBY
       end
+
+      it 'registers an offense when `end` is not aligned with the start of the singleton method definition' do
+        expect_offense(<<~RUBY)
+          def self.foo = bar do
+            baz
+              end
+              ^^^ `end` at 3, 4 is not aligned with `def self.foo = bar do` at 1, 0.
+        RUBY
+
+        expect_correction(<<~RUBY)
+          def self.foo = bar do
+            baz
+          end
+        RUBY
+      end
     end
   end
```
Thank you for pointing this out. I've updated the PR now to cover `defs` nodes as well.
